name: Astral Fang
description:
Your weapon is inscribed with an astral rune, so that it causes spiritual as well as physical damage.

The first time the affected weapon deals Damage, it gains the Magical trait, and deals additional damage equal to your Soul, or double your Soul if the ability user spent 1 Resolve.

Wounds inflicted by this attack do not recover naturally and require active treatment to be healed. Lost Stamina recovers normally.
